name: Badaun

queries.query: Badaun Uttar Pradesh official cadastral map land records parcel GIS BhuNaksha
queries.result: First-party Uttar Pradesh BhuNaksha, UP Bhulekh, Budaun district administration, and the official cadastral-map digitization dashboard were found. The dashboard reports Badaun district and Badaun tehsil cadastral villages/maps linked to Bhunaksha, while the current public BhuNaksha application is login-gated.

queries.query: बदायूं उत्तर प्रदेश आधिकारिक भू नक्शा भूमि अभिलेख नक्शा
queries.result: Hindi first-party discovery confirmed the Budaun district administration land-records route and UP Bhulekh/BhuNaksha. The official application lists बदायूँ as district code 149; no anonymous parcel geometry or safe native parcel identity was exposed.

portals.name: BhuNaksha Uttar Pradesh
portals.operator: Government of Uttar Pradesh / Revenue Council and NIC
portals.observation: Current Angular application was fetched over HTTPS. Its public login page lists District बदायूँ (code 149), but requests for plot/map data are not available anonymously without login; no credentials or CAPTCHA interaction was attempted.

portals.name: UP Bhulekh cadastral digitization dashboard
portals.observation: Official public dashboard reports Badaun tehsil with 387 linked villages, 483 linked mapsheets, and 375 geo-referenced villages; this is registry/digitization coverage evidence, not an open parcel-vector endpoint.

requests.result: Current public application HTML and JavaScript fetched; login form and CAPTCHA were present. No login was attempted.
Anonymous response returned 0; this did not establish absence of Badaun coverage.
Safe administrative metadata returned district code 149 बदायूँ and tehsil choices including 00782 बदायूँ. No parcel fields or geometry requested.
Village-level anonymous request for code 00782 returned a 403 from the upstream internal API; no retry with credentials or bypass was attempted.
Anonymous Badaun tehsil extent request returned upstream 403; no geometry or CRS response was obtained.

registryBasis: UP Bhulekh and BhuNaksha are first-party Uttar Pradesh land-record/cadastral services, and the official dashboard explicitly reports Badaun district/tehsil digitization and linkage to Bhunaksha. This establishes relevant registry custody but not an open parcel-vector integration.

source.name: Uttar Pradesh official Bhulekh and BhuNaksha cadastral services
source.operator: Government of Uttar Pradesh / Revenue Council and NIC
source.serviceType: Public cadastral viewer reviewed; anonymous parcel geometry and stable native identity not verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Uttar Pradesh public BhuNaksha/land-record system with Badaun district and tehsil administrative entries; official dashboard reports linked and geo-referenced Badaun cadastral coverage.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous application metadata, Badaun district/tehsil enumeration, and official dashboard coverage counts only.

technicalBlocker: The current public BhuNaksha application exposes a login/CAPTCHA wall. Anonymous village-level and map-extent requests reached upstream 403 responses, so no safe parcel geometry, CRS, or native parcel identity was verified.
remainingUncertainty: The authenticated or UI-mediated BhuNaksha workflow may expose parcel maps or report images for Badaun. No exact-point hit or map extent miss is interpreted as citywide absence.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later researcher may inspect a documented anonymous public BhuNaksha route if the service changes, confirming safe schema, CRS, stable native identity, and geometry before retaining a sample.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
